theme_and_archetype.description: A premium, cutting-edge, matrix-inspired dark UI. Deep void blacks mixed with frosted glass surfaces and sharp, deliberate neon green accents. It must not feel cheap or gamery, but rather like an exclusive, high-tech command center.

rules.headings: Tight letter spacing (tracking-tight), never default to standard sans like Inter. Use Azeret Mono for a technical, matrix vibe.
rules.body: Clean, highly readable geometric sans. Outfit works perfectly.
rules.hierarchy: H1 up to text-5xl/6xl. Do not exceed. Strong contrast in weight.

layout_and_spacing.container: Max-width 7xl (1280px). Generous padding (p-8 to p-12 on desktop).
layout_and_spacing.grid: Bento-style 'Tetris' grid for the Features section. Asymmetry creates tension and interest.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x more spacing than typical designs. Massive gaps between sections (py-24 or py-32).

navigation.style: Crystal Glassmorphism (bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10). Sticky top, z-50.
navigation.elements: Logo left, Links center, 'Get Started' button right.

hero.background: Custom HTML5 Canvas or tsParticles Matrix digital rain effect with subtle neon green highlights. Overlay with bg-black/60 to ensure text readability.
hero.layout: Centered, high impact. Large logo, bold heading (text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter).
hero.ctas: Primary: Solid #00FF66 background, black text. Secondary: Transparent with #00FF66 border and text. Hover effects must increase brightness.

features.style: Glassmorphism cards. bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md border border-white/10. On hover, the border transitions to border-[#00FF66]/50 with a subtle neon drop-shadow.
features.layout: 8 cards in an asymmetrical bento grid. Mix col-span-1 and col-span-2 items.

pricing.style: Two prominent cards. Quarterly card uses the 'Tracing Beam' or glowing border effect to stand out as 'Most Popular'.
pricing.quarterly_card: Border #00FF66, subtle inset neon glow, 'Most Popular' badge at the top.
pricing.annual_card: Standard glassmorphism style, muted to drive focus to Quarterly.

testimonials.style: Dark glass cards, subtle typography. Avatars aligned left.

faq.style: Shadcn Accordion component, customized to remove standard borders and use a dark, tech-focused look with neon green active states.

contact.style: Massive CTA area. Headline: 'Ready to Start Watching?'. Primary CTA is a Telegram button with the Telegram icon.
contact.floating_elements: Fixed bottom-right Telegram bubble. Fixed bottom-center mobile 'Get Started' button.

logo.instruction: Use the uploaded OMGTV logo provided by the user. If unavailable, use a clean text logo with the primary font until asset is injected.

icons.instruction: Use Lucide React for standard UI icons. Use react-icons/fa for the Telegram icon. yarn add react-icons.

animations.hero_matrix: MUST implement a custom Canvas or tsParticles effect for the falling green matrix code.
animations.hover_states: All buttons must transition transform and brightness. Feature cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) and gain a neon border glow.
animations.scroll: Use Lenis or framer-motion for smooth scrolling and staggered section fade-ins.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text over the matrix background has sufficient contrast (use bg-black/60 overlay minimum).
accessibility_and_testing.test_ids: MUST add data-testid to all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='hero-cta-button', data-testid='faq-accordion-item-1').

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a premium, dark-mode landing page for OMGTV.
Follow the Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) theme. Do not invent unrelated colors.
Use standard HTML/Tailwind for main layout structures. Avoid Shadcn for standard cards to maintain creative freedom.
Use Shadcn ONLY for complex interactive logic like the FAQ Accordion.
DO NOT use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings. Apply Azeret Mono for headings and Outfit for body.
Implement the matrix background in the Hero section via Canvas or a library.
Ensure the Quarterly pricing card visually dominates the Annual one.
Include the floating Telegram button and mobile sticky CTA.
Include data-testid attributes on every button, link, and interactive element to ensure testing passes.
